additives.name: Tartrazine
additives.concern: Azo dye associated with hyperactivity in sensitive children and mild allergic reactions in aspirin-sensitive individuals.

additives.name: Sunset Yellow FCF
additives.concern: Azo dye commonly flagged for potential intolerance reactions in children.

additives.name: Carmoisine (Azorubine)
additives.concern: Synthetic azo dye; banned or restricted in several jurisdictions.

additives.name: Ponceau 4R
additives.concern: Synthetic dye subject to warning labels in the EU.

additives.name: Caramel IV (Sulphite Ammonia Caramel)
additives.purpose: Deep brown colouring in colas, sauces, and baked goods
additives.concern: Manufactured using ammonium and sulphite compounds; contains traces of 4-MEI.

additives.name: Sodium Benzoate
additives.purpose: Inhibits mold, yeast, and bacterial growth in acidic foods
additives.concern: When combined with Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid), can form trace benzene under heat/light.

additives.name: Potassium Sorbate
additives.concern: Generally regarded as safe; rare contact sensitivity reported.

additives.name: Sodium Metabisulphite
additives.purpose: Prevents browning in biscuits, dried fruits, and juices
additives.concern: Sulphites can trigger severe bronchial constriction in asthmatic individuals.

additives.name: Monosodium Glutamate (MSG)
additives.concern: FSSAI requires explicit declaration. May cause sensitivity symptoms in a small subset of consumers.

additives.name: Disodium Inosinate & Guanylate (I+G)
additives.purpose: Synergistic umami booster often paired with MSG in snacks and noodles
additives.concern: Metabolized to purines; individuals with gout or uric acid issues should be aware.

additives.name: TBHQ
additives.purpose: Prevents oxidation and rancidity in vegetable oils and fried snacks
additives.concern: Synthetic antioxidant strictly regulated with maximum permissible usage limits.

additives.name: Acesulfame Potassium
additives.concern: Often blended with other artificial sweeteners; long-term metabolic effects widely debated.

additives.name: Aspartame
additives.purpose: Intense sweetener for low-calorie beverages and chewing gum
additives.concern: Unsafe for individuals with Phenylketonuria (PKU). Classified as 'possibly carcinogenic' (IARC Group 2B).

additives.name: Sucralose
additives.concern: Heat-stable sweetener; emerging research studies impacts on gut microbiome.
